_note: Frozen content for design review. Narrative: hook, the honest problem, three capability slides, the limit, the close.
brief: How an AI assistant replaced most of a sales team

slots.subLine: Not because the work went away. Because most of what a junior seller does all day is not selling.
slots.note: Here is what actually got handed over

slots.step1Sub: Reading the company, finding the angle, writing the note. Every day, before a single conversation happened.
slots.step2Sub: Logging calls, updating stages, chasing the follow-up nobody wrote down.
slots.step3Sub: The only part anyone was actually hired for, and the only part that was never the bottleneck.

slots.step1Sub: Scans target accounts overnight and compiles fresh contacts against the profile you defined once.
slots.step2Sub: Ranks on company shape, stack and recent signals, so the top of the list is worth the first hour.
slots.step3Sub: Writes a first message per prospect from what the company actually shipped, not a merge field.

slots.step1Sub: Turns the site, the notes and the last three threads into a brief you can hold in your head.
slots.step2Sub: Surfaces the funding round, the new hire, the launch — the reason this week is different from last week.
slots.step3Sub: Suggests the angles and the two questions most likely to come back at you.

slots.step1Sub: It cannot hear hesitation in a voice or tell when the real decision-maker went quiet on the call.
slots.step2Sub: Trust accrues to a person over months. Nobody renews because the follow-up was well written.
slots.step3Sub: It will happily send the seventh message. A person knows the sixth already cost you the account.

slots.step1Sub: One person now covers what took three, because the preparation stopped being a person's job.
slots.step2Sub: The screen is no longer about output. It is about knowing which deals are real.
slots.step3Sub: The conversation is the whole job now, and it is the part worth paying properly for.

slots.step1Sub: Automating everything at once means you cannot tell which part is working and which is noise.
slots.step2Sub: Outbound can be machine-written. The response to a real reply should not be.
slots.step3Sub: Week-to-week numbers on a pipeline this small are mostly luck wearing a suit.

slots.body: It replaced the six hours around the selling. That turned out to be most of the cost, and none of the value.
